property_summary: For any call to version(), the reference contract always returns the string "1.0.0", while the buggy contract returns "2.0.0"; the bug violates the invariant that version() returns the string starting with "1.".
change_summary: Change the return string from "1.0.0" to "2.0.0"
mutated_unit_code: function version() external pure returns (string memory) { return "2.0.0"; }
